# Findings

> Minor notes on things I find interesting, and my own research.

This site publishes minor research notes. Every note has a Markdown version at the same URL with .md appended; agents should prefer those. A concatenated dump of all notes is at /llms-full.txt for grep-based retrieval. A machine-readable manifest is at /notes/index.json.
